svg.title: AgentBuff: how work flows
svg.desc: 1. Discover (Business owner): Reads the landing page, the marketplace or the blog and starts the 14-day free trial. 2. Sign in (Business owner): Signs in with Google and answers a short onboarding about the business. 3. Give it a brain (Business owner): Logs in with a ChatGPT subscription or pastes a key from one of 25+ AI providers, some of them free. 4. Hire (Business owner): Recruits a ready-made employee from the marketplace, answers its interview questions, or builds one from scratch. 5. Connect channels (Business owner): Pairs WhatsApp or a Telegram bot to the employee and chooses who may chat with it. 6. Delegate (AI employee): Works through chats, tasks on the board and scheduled routines, and asks the owner when it needs a decision. 7. Subscribe (Business owner): Pays for OP Buff through Midtrans with QRIS, e-wallets or virtual accounts when the trial ends.
svg.text: From the first step to the last, and who does what.
